title.narrative: Supporting Morocco’s national mitigation action in the waste sector

description.narrative: The three landfills to be assessed the ones located in Rabat, Tanger, and Safir. The landfills were selected by the Moroccan Government based on the criteria of biogas potential, availability, and awareness of stakeholders for waste recovery, with a view to mitigating methane emissions

This project responds to a request by Morocco’s Ministry of Energy Transition and Sustainable Development to provide technical support for feasibility assessments for three major landfills (I.e., Tangier, Rabat, and Casablanca) in Morocco, for the evaluation of methane mitigation strategies in the waste sector and for a proposal for a MRV framework.The objective of this project is to assess the methane mitigation potential at three landfills in Morocco and to provide technical, financial, and institutional feasibility assessments of landfill gas to energy projects and to suggest a Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) system for this polluting gas to:A. Establish a solid basis for large-scale methane emission reduction in the Kingdom of Morocco from the waste sector by providing technical support,B. Propose alternative solutions such as composting and/or anaerobic digestion allowing the diversion of organic waste from landfills and/or open dumps,C. Reinforce climate ambitions, by suggesting mitigation waste projects eligible for the mobilization of climate finance and carbon finance, andD. Propose an MRV framework for methane in the waste sector compatible with the national MRV platform and UNFCCC recommendations
